_comment: Facts about the school, not about parsing. Every value here is something
the INSP can change without telling anyone, and each one used to be a
constant in the code: a new LV1 room, a renamed column or a different
sport keyword meant a parser release. It is now a data change.
Bump `version` whenever anything below changes. It is reported by
/api/health and written into every calendar as X-INSPCAL-RULES, so the
rules a given export was produced under can be read off the file.
Anything that is a *parsing* decision — geometry ratios, how speakers are
split, how a title is folded — stays in the code. This file is only for
